description: Set up Engagemii AI-crawler monitoring for a site the user owns. The tracker key goes only to the verified owner of the site: if the email given is the site's verified owner, Engagemii emails it the site's tracker key and install steps (Node/Express, Next.js, PHP, Cloudflare Worker or WordPress); the key is never returned in the chat, and a site has one key. Otherwise the answer explains how to claim and verify the site at engagemii.com/portal/brand. The site shows as connected only after the tracker reports its first AI crawler visit. Terms of the free service: Engagemii licenses the AI-crawler activity data the tracker collects, in aggregated form and, unless the owner opts out in portal settings, identified by their domain. The tracker records bot visits only, never human visitors.

email.description: The site owner's email (required). The key is emailed there only when it is the site's verified owner.

name: connect_tracker

connected.description: Always false here: a site shows as connected after the tracker reports its first AI crawler visit

title: Set up AI crawler monitoring
